scientific_question: Can the wide but token-stable c_proj residual-output frame be amortized as one learned residual-space basis across all 12 layers and 8 experts while preserving 200--500x total c_proj trainable-state compression?

theory_reconciliation.observed_boundary: At 200x, eight rank-2 experts can recover at most 0.4540 of the joint routed residual write on average. The joint ranks needed for 80% and 90% energy are about 143 and 274, while cross-bank output-subspace overlap stays about 0.78--0.91 through rank 64.
theory_reconciliation.selected_class: The output frame is wide but stable. Per-matrix storage is too expensive, and the equal-budget full-rank MPO recovered only about 0.358. The next distinct class is therefore one residual-space basis shared model-wide, with compact per-matrix coordinates generating coefficients into that basis.
theory_reconciliation.not_private_lora: A private learned basis for every matrix would be a low-rank adapter and violates the state budget. This oracle counts exactly one basis over all 96 sparse-expert c_proj matrices. It tests a common residual coordinate system, not 96 private LoRA modules.
theory_reconciliation.optimism: For a frozen shared basis U, every evaluated action is projected with oracle coefficients Y U. This ignores whether the registered per-matrix coordinate budgets can causally generate those coefficients and therefore upper-bounds the proposed class.
theory_reconciliation.cross_bank_causality: U is derived from all layers on discovery A and scored unchanged on discovery B and heldout; the symmetric B-to-A/heldout direction is also required. Independent bases must agree geometrically.
theory_reconciliation.state_accounting: Total dense c_proj state is 12*8*768*1536=113,246,208 values. Every layout counts 96 per-matrix coordinate vectors plus one explicit 768-by-r shared basis. Ranks are the largest integers that do not exceed the registered global compression budget.
theory_reconciliation.why_not_training: A pass establishes only shareable output orientation. It authorizes a separate fixed-operator coefficient-generation oracle, never direct implementation, MFU work, language-model training, or a larger rung.

functional_protocol.score: Exact terminal c_proj minus exact reproducible step-zero c_proj, applied to terminal same-run routing and c_fc activations in every transformer layer.
functional_protocol.anti_leakage: Each shared basis is derived from exactly one discovery bank. It is scored unchanged on the other discovery bank and heldout bank; no evaluation action changes the basis or layout.

decision_rule.pass: A layout passes only if both independently fitted bases satisfy every gate on the other discovery bank and heldout bank. The highest-compression passing layout is selected; ties prefer fewer per-matrix coordinates.
decision_rule.fail: If no layout passes, a single model-wide residual-output frame is not sufficient at the registered budgets. Do not sweep rank or layouts; return to theory on layer-grouped frames or an explicit residual-write exception.
decision_rule.post_pass: A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered oracle for producing the shared-basis coefficients from the registered per-matrix coordinates with a fixed procedural operator.

scope_caveat: Projection coefficients are oracle values and the basis is endpoint-selected from one discovery bank. The test establishes only output-frame shareability and state accounting. It does not show that a causal compact coefficient generator, optimizer, or training trajectory can reach the represented function.
